entities.name: Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale
entities.description: One or two mystical buildings, one in Pendrell Vale on Tolaria and one in Scarwood in Jamuraa, a holy site of the cat warriors.

entities.name: Scarwood
entities.description: A place in Jamuraa containing a tabernacle.

entities.name: Pendrell Vale
entities.description: A place on Tolaria, shrouded in impenetrable mists.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: An island blasted away by Barrin's Blare of Doom.

entities.name: Terrent Amese
entities.description: Creator of the cat warriors, minotaurs, viashino and Ur-Drago, depicted in the vault murals; he abandoned the tabernacle.

entities.name: Jedit Ojanen
entities.description: Rebuilt the tabernacle with his cat warrior followers after Johan's War.

entities.name: Cat warriors
entities.description: A people created by Terrent Amese who hold the Scarwood tabernacle holy.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Caster of the Blare of Doom that blasted Tolaria away.

entities.name: Johan's War
entities.description: A war after which the Scarwood tabernacle was rebuilt.

events.summary: After being abandoned by Terrent Amese and his creations, the Scarwood tabernacle falls into ruin for over 900 years.
events.quote: After being abandoned by both Terrent Amese and his creations, the tabernacle fell into ruin for over 900 years

events.summary: After Johan's War, Jedit Ojanen and his cat warrior followers rebuild the tabernacle.
events.quote: it was rebuilt by Jedit Ojanen and his cat warrior followers

relations.note: Rebuilt the tabernacle with his cat warrior followers.
relations.quote: it was rebuilt by Jedit Ojanen and his cat warrior followers

relations.note: The murals depict his creation of them.
relations.quote: the history of Terrent Amese and the creation of the cat warriors
